title: Apple Music setQueue runs inside the iOS Start gesture
acceptance: On deployed iPhone Safari with RF-122 live, record whether a real Start tap reaches setQueue and play() reliably, or whether setQueue still hangs without a gesture.
If it hangs, propose a change that issues MusicKit setQueue/play within the Start tap (or a prepared-on-tap step) with its test plan; do not implement without owner approval.
nextAction: Check during the RF-29 retry: if Break Stuff plays from a real Start tap, close this as not needed. Owner-gated (playback code).

evidence.summary: Owner iPhone Safari 2026-10-28, console-driven: setQueue({songs:['1440754477']}) timed out at 20 s twice without Emulate User Gesture and resolved in 313 ms with it. runtime.ts awaits prepare (setQueue) before play().
